title: Rosemary scalp oil
subtitle: A light scalp treatment oil for dry scalp and hair growth support
excerpt: A scalp treatment oil made on a jojoba-and-castor base with rosemary essential oil. Massaged into the scalp, left for 20 minutes or overnight, then washed out. The rosemary content is at 2%, within the range used in studies comparing rosemary oil to minoxidil 2% for hair loss. Gives about 50 ml. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis / Salvia rosmarinus) essential oil for scalp use: Panahi et al. 2015 (Skinmed journal) compared rosemary oil at 2% with minoxidil 2% in a 6-month RCT, both showed similar hair count improvement. Mechanism proposed: inhibition of 5-alpha-reductase and improved dermal papilla circulation. IFRA guideline for leave-on scalp: rosemary EO max 0.5% as leave-on, but since this product is a rinse-out treatment, higher concentrations (up to 2-3%) are used in published research. Jojoba is oxidatively stable (very low polyunsaturate content); castor oil adds viscosity to keep the oil on the scalp. Formulation: 88% jojoba + 10% castor + 2% rosemary EO by weight.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale to 100 ml easily, use within 12 months. A 100 ml bottle is typically a 3-4 month supply at once-weekly use.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready immediately. Jojoba is very stable; the blend lasts 12 months without refrigeration.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months. Jojoba (technically a liquid wax) is extremely stable. Discard if the oil develops a rancid or musty smell.

glossaryTerms.definition: Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis) is technically a liquid wax rather than an oil. It is extremely oxidatively stable, non-comedogenic, and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, a common base for scalp and skin treatments.

An enzyme involved in converting testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), which plays a role in androgenic hair loss. Some plant compounds, including rosemary constituents, are proposed to inhibit this enzyme, though evidence remains limited.

items.prepNote: 88% of formula; non-greasy wax ester that mimics sebum; good for all scalp types
10% of formula; adds body and helps the oil cling to the scalp

content.text: Combine all three ingredients in the amber bottle. Roll gently to mix.

Apply 5-10 drops to sections of the scalp. Massage in with fingertips for 2-4 minutes. Leave on for at least 20 minutes (or overnight with a towel on the pillow) then wash out thoroughly. Use once or twice a week. Results, if any, take a minimum of 3-6 months of consistent use.
12 months in an amber bottle, away from light. Jojoba is one of the most stable carrier oils and does not require refrigeration. Discard if it develops any off smell.
